title: Hearts of Plastic, episode 2: The Hall
part: Hearts of Plastic (odyssey/writers-room/BIBLE.md): an episode shot on the set of OD-B17-S05
hypothesis: A stool reads as thrown if it is seen in the air for more than half a second.
variable: Casting two figures that are the same part for part, and re-shooting the stool's throw on the hall's own set with the take-three flight and smear bricks (the production re-shoot of OD-B17-S05 in odyssey/experiments/OD-B17-S05.json).
held: Irus as OD-B18-S02's card has him
true_to: the two beggars: odyssey/cards/OD-B18-S02.mpd: Irus and the beggar are the same minifigure part for part and colour for colour (973p3a, 3626bp4g, 3901, 93223, 3957a, 10169); camera note OD-B18-S02: "Odysseus and Irus are both white-bearded beggars and hard to tell apart" (still wrong)
the unknown beggar: halfworld e55c649: the stage direction read aloud ("For news and enters the hut beside the unknown beggar?"), the making-of part two
the suitor dressed as the beggar: camera note OD-B17-S05: "one of the rebuking suitors wears the same white beard and red vest as the beggar"
a third of a second: camera note OD-B17-S05: "the stool's flight lasts a third of a second and lands out of the wide's frame"; tools/perform/scenes/OD-B17-S05.js FL = 0.33 (take 2, 8135f3e5)

the experiment and the new throw: odyssey/experiments/OD-B17-S05.json; take 3 of OD-B17-S05 (tools/perform/keeptake.py): FL 0.6, the smear bricks (tools/forage/keyprops.js stoolSmear; film-readymades/choreo.js applyFlights)

metrics_before.stage: scored and planned, before rendering (perform.js measure; the dev contact sheet)

metrics_after.stage: rendered and assembled (films/odyssey/hearts-of-plastic-e2.*; contact sheet reviewed)

result: Kept, confirmed. The two beggars stand side by side in a two-shot and are the same figure, beard, vest, rags and staff ('Irus is the one on the left.' 'I'm on the right.'), held again at the end ('Do I get a stool?'). On the hall's set, take two of the throw is a wide: the stool leaves Antinous's hand and is gone in a few drawings ('A third of a second. And it landed outside the frame.'), and its dailies (8135f3e5) say the same. Take three's dailies (the re-shoot, films/odyssey/OD-B17-S05-performed.mp4) carry the button: the stool is seen in the air across the wide, drawn long in reddish brown smear bricks for two drawings, and lands in the same shot ('Print it.'). Weak: the episode's own take three is played in Antinous's close, so the stool swings across his face and out of frame and the flight is seen only in the dailies; the director's closes have the back of a crew head at the edge of frame; the AD's closes are half headset and clipboard.
